basis: operation-matrix.py plus docs/testing/engine-goal-scope.md; live tools/list is the authoritative exposed catalog
stressMode: --requested-count-stress asks for the requested logical count concurrently; service refusals are measured, never retried
scope: Full imported primary document. Original nodes across its actual pages are edited/read. New copies/SVG controls live inside that full authority and are removed; no empty replacement board.
limits: A bounded write/render budget can yield partial coverage, never a 1000-client pass from fewer attempted clients.
Global shared-history undo/redo workflows are explicitly serialized; isolated per-agent undo is not claimed.

Use --managed-primary-save-before-ack only for a verified binary: bound Managed command acknowledgements include atomic save. live-final-save adds one final checkpoint; save-after-each-write adds a redundant explicit RPC. Neither flag changes server behavior or proves power-loss recovery.
No external network, stock-image, AI/provider or LLM subprocess tool is invoked.
Full-file alternate-path admission is recorded from fixture inventory; no source-cap increase or selected-page replacement is used.

Independent family write budgets do not guarantee completed1000writer workflows before deadline. Started/accepted/rejected/unconfirmed participants are reported; serialized variable/theme workflows explicitly use maxInflight1.
Variable/theme map restoration uses immediate shared undo under serialized family workflows, preserving None versus empty. No arbitrary canonical fields are dropped.

families.reason: Requires an actual engine/viewport interaction driver; do not substitute snapshot_layout for hit-testing or snapping.
No boolean/contour operation is fabricated by this MCP harness. Matching live tools, if any, are listed as available-not-benchmarked.
Rendering a masked original is not proof of edit-operation throughput or all blend modes.
Computed-layout read is measured; exhaustive constraints/reflow/align editing is a separate missing workload.
HTTP shared authority is exercised; network collaboration conflicts, crash recovery and agent-local undo are not.
Both full corpus documents exceed the existing alternate-file16MiB source admission cap. Primary startup is measured; no partial document replaces it.
PNG actual-node export is measured; JPEG/WebP/PDF, SVG export and all encoding/scaling combinations remain explicit gaps.
This matrix opens the full converted canonical document. It does not substitute canonical startup for binary.fig decode/conversion; importer reports are separate.
No external models, network image providers or outbound agent services are exercised; exposed tools are inventoried rather than called.

families.scope: Page-root grouping/ungrouping actualimportedcopies; nested is a distinctcontrol below.
Left/top alignment of real imported copies; other edge/center/distribute modes are not inferred.
All4scalar kinds; immediateUndo cleanup to retain exact optional-map presence. No variable-ref binding or bulk replace claim.
Own-axis merge plus immediateUndo cleanup; no axis switch/resolution/bulk replace claim.
Same-parent nested sibling grouping/ungrouping of owned copies of actual imported nodes; arbitrary existing Group transform/effect flattening is not inferred.

budgetModes.global: --write-budget64 retains the earlier shared reservation cap; later families can be explicitly deferred.
budgetModes.family: --write-budget-scope family independently reserves logicalClients × each workflow mutation count; --family-write-budget optionally caps each family. Scheduling does not imply completion or all writers.

historicalFamilyRemainders.reason: Token/theme operations require dedicated semantic fixtures; no pass is inferred from reading nodes.
remainingUnmeasured: Variable-reference bindings, themed resolution, active-axis switching, bulk replacement and theme presets remain unmeasured.

historicalFamilyRemainders.reason: Coordinate move and resize are measured. Hierarchy/layer ordering/grouping/alignment operations require additional controls and are not inferred.
remainingUnmeasured: Arbitrary authored Group transform/effect flattening, every alignment/distribution mode and transformed rendered-pixel equivalence remain unmeasured.
